what: [research-starved-by-ci-backlog] research-queue-dispatch defers EVERY fire when > 10 runs are queued repo-wide (--max-repo-queued 10). At 09:37Z 2026-10-16 the 27 fresh queued runs were mostly claude-run-failure-alert (13 created 09:35-09:45Z; 37 of ~60 runs since 08:00Z end `skipped` -- it is a workflow_run listener on ~60 workflows incl. pytest-run, and every completion creates a run that queues for a slot even when its job `if:` will skip) while ~20 runs (pytest-run x9, Guards x6) held the account's concurrent-job pool. So lane CI bursts starve research for whole cycles. Options for the manager: (a) exclude workflow_run-listener runs from the repo-queued count, (b) add `branches: [main]` / narrow claude-run-failure-alert's trigger so PR pytest-run completions do not create runs, (c) raise the cap. Separately 38 queued runs are debris from 2026-05-15 / 09-12/13 / 08-06 / 10-01 (vm-web-api-recover, vm-cloud-fix, trainer-vm-diag, ...) that never start; the dispatcher already ignores >24h, but humans reading status=queued are misled (manager read '62 queued'). Cancelling them via the API was refused in this lane's session.
